newsitem.title: USA: Lincoln National life operating income up.
newsitem.headline: Lincoln National life operating income up.

text.p: Lincoln National Corp said operating income from its life insurance and annuities segment rose 17 percent in the fourth quarter to $79.9 million.
Annuity operating income rose 26 percent to $50.3 million in the fourth quarter, Lincoln National said.
"Our powerful annuities operation continues to drive earnings growth," Lincoln National chief executive Ian M. Rolland said.
"Record operating earnings by our reinsurance and United Kingdom companies contributed to a fine year with promising fourth-quarter momentum," Rolland said.

For the year, operating income from the life insurance and annuities segment rose 16 percent to more than $290 million, representing almost 60 percent of Lincoln National's total operating segment results. Annuity deposits rose nine percent in 1996 to $4.0 billion.
Life insurance premiums for the segment's United States operations increased 18 percent from 1995 and agent productivity continued to improve, Lincoln National said.

Lincoln National attributed the gains in the life and annuity business in part to a transformation of processes begun at Lincoln Life in 1995 to create major improvements in service, products and expense levels.
Expenses related to transformation efforts reduced operating earnings $5.9 million, after-tax, in the fourth quarter and $18.5 million, after-tax, for all of 1996.
The initial phase of these efforts is expected to be completed by the end of 1997, Lincoln National said.

Lincoln National said its reinsurance segment reported 1996 operating income of $74.0 million compared with a loss in 1995 due to a special charge for disability income insurance reserve strengthening.
Individual and group life reinsurance business in-force increased 13 percent to $160.9 billion.
A rebound in financial reinsurance earnings in 1996 was partially offset by increased claims in group markets.
Operating income from Lincoln's U.K. business grew to $66.0 million in 1996, up from $45.9 million in 1995.
Fourth-quarter operating income rose to $15.4 million from $9.8 million a year ago.
Lincoln National said its British affiliate had a 21 percent increase in production of new business.
Assets managed by Lincoln National rose 11 percent to end the year in excess of $105 billion.
